I arrived in search of delicious Vietnamese food!
Mar 2025 • Couples
This restaurant is located in "V-Cuisine" Old Town, 13 minutes walk from "St. Joseph Cathedral"! Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc Square is about a 5-minute walk away.

If you look at the menu, it's authentic Vietnamese food! Vegetarians & vegans are also served on meats, vegetables from soul foods like Buncha and Pho ☆ Aunt Owner is very kind! It's a family-run restaurant and the natural hospitality is nice ♡ Customers are tourists! This is probably why the cosy, laid-back atmosphere and service are so popular.

We had "buncha", "pho" and "raw spring rolls of shrimp".

First, I ate Buncha at a popular restaurant on the first day of Hanoi the other day. The soup tastes good and the meat dumplings grilled over charcoal are good ☆ It's delicious to dip noodles ♡ It's interesting to add lime and chili and change the taste! If you're looking to eat "buncha" in Hanoi's Old Quarter, this is the place to go.

The "Four" is great, too! The soup stock is gentle and nice! The amount of noodles is surprisingly large, but it's delicious when eaten with toppings such as meat, onions and green onions! A complete meal would be a must ♡ The fresh spring rolls of shrimp were also delicious! I thought that whatever I ate here would be delicious.

I found the most delicious Vietnamese food! Recommended restaurant in Hanoi Old Quarter ☆ Thank you for the feast.

Store Name: V-Cuisine
Address: 29 Hàng Giầy Hanoi, Vietnam 10000
Tel: +84 97 442 63 93

great value for tasty food although the service is a bit unpredictable
Mar 2023
The servings are a good size and great value. The shredded chicken salad comes with peanuts on top and was delicious. Sometimes the service was great but one time we ordered 2 dishes, only 1 turned up and when we asked about the 2nd it still didn't turn up so we gave up and left. Still worth going again then we discovered another V-Cuisine just around the corner (29 P. Hàng Giầy, Hàng Buồm, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam) with the same menu and more reliable service.
